definitions.explanation: A hoofed mammal with antlers (in males). Deer are common in Japan and are famously tame in places like Nara.

examples.japanese: {奈良公園|ならこうえん}には{鹿|しか}がたくさんいる。
examples.english: There are many deer in Nara Park.

examples.japanese: {鹿|しか}せんべいを{買|か}って{鹿|しか}に{あげ|あげ}た。
examples.english: I bought deer crackers and gave them to the deer.

examples.japanese: {雄|おす}の{鹿|しか}は{立派|りっぱ}な{角|つの}を{持|も}っている。

notes:
{鹿|しか} refers to deer. Also pronounced {鹿|か} in some compounds.

Common expressions:
- {鹿|しか}せんべい (deer crackers - sold in Nara for feeding deer)
- {鹿|しか}の{角|つの} (deer antler)
- {馬鹿|ばか} (fool - uses the kanji for horse and deer)
- {鹿|しか}{肉|にく} (venison)

Counter: {頭|とう} or {匹|ひき}

Cultural note:
The deer of {奈良|なら} are famous worldwide and considered sacred as messengers of the gods of {春日大社|かすがたいしゃ}. They roam freely in Nara Park and bow to visitors for crackers. Miyajima's Itsukushima Shrine also has free-roaming deer. In other areas, deer overpopulation causes agricultural damage.
